name: Multi-Hazard Event
description: Combination of river flooding, road collapse near Sanganer, and power outage at Jagatpura.

alert.title: CRITICAL: Sanganer Nala Overflowing
alert.description: Amanishah Nala has breached banks near Sanganer. 28,000 residents at immediate risk.

alert.title: POWER OUTAGE: Jagatpura Substation Flooded
alert.description: Electricity supply disrupted across Jagatpura and surrounding 8 sectors. Estimated restoration: 4-6 hours.

alert.title: ROAD COLLAPSE: Dravyavati Bridge Unsafe
alert.description: Structural damage detected at Dravyavati bridge near Sanganer crossing. Bridge sealed immediately.

alert.title: RESCUE OPS: NDRF Deployed at Sanganer
alert.description: 45-member NDRF team with 6 rescue boats deployed. Helicopter rescue requested for isolated residents.

alert.title: CRITICAL: Jagatpura Fully Inundated
alert.description: Water depth 1.2m in Jagatpura sectors 4-8. Emergency evacuation by boat only. Call 112 for assistance.

alert.title: WARNING: Cascading Flood Risk — Pratap Nagar
alert.description: Floodwater from Sanganer nala reaching Pratap Nagar via low-lying channels. Precautionary evacuation.

alert.title: MAXIMUM ALERT: Multi-Zone Emergency Active
alert.description: 5 zones now at HIGH or CRITICAL. All available shelters operational. Evacuate immediately via designated routes.
